{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "direct-judge",
  "task_id": "LEV-CH01-EQ-1.6-ACOUSTICS-MATRIX-CANONICAL-20260908",
  "source_sha256": "b3adec0d3616dbde57a5522cfce1861890887d7c03a2232d2136cb94c9bac1d5",
  "dossier_sha256": "2461e8af551d91089175eb7452a808280e88b4840abbfc633ed826a778bfe9f0",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "NumStability.leveque01_equation01_constantLinearSystemAt",
      "interpretation": "Abbreviation for the constant-coefficient linear-system solution predicate at x,t, forwarding all arguments unchanged.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applies D005 to the specified two-component acoustic state and coefficient matrix.",
      "source_match": "Matches the use of the general system (1.1) in the sentence preceding (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "NumStability.leveque01_equation05_linearAcousticsAt",
      "interpretation": "Abbreviation for D006, preserving the pressure, velocity, material parameters, and evaluation point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the right-hand proposition the two scalar acoustic equations with derivative existence.",
      "source_match": "Matches equation (1.5) on printed page 2.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "NumStability.linearAcousticsMatrix",
      "interpretation": "The real two-by-two matrix with rows (0,bulkModulus) and (density inverse,0).",
      "effect_on_target": "Its action on (px,ux) is (bulkModulus*ux,density inverse*px). It is independent of x,t.",
      "source_match": "Exactly matches A in (1.6), including row order and constant coefficients; the target excludes zero density.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "NumStability.linearAcousticsState",
      "interpretation": "At x,t, forms the Fin 2 vector whose first value is pressure x t and second value is velocity x t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the state and derivative component ordering to pressure followed by velocity.",
      "source_match": "Exactly matches the column q=(p,u) in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "NumStability.IsConstantCoefficientLinearSystemSolutionAt",
      "reuse_sha256": "af9d44f338cf37d016f385637a8fe0a769d3336204c1724aed5de2131576ccef",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires actual time and space derivatives of the acoustic vector slices and the vector equality qt+A qx=0 at x,t.",
      "source_match": "Matches (1.1) specialized as in (1.6). Finite-product derivatives express precisely the component partial derivatives used in (1.5).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "NumStability.IsLinearAcousticsSolutionAt",
      "interpretation": "There exist pt,px,ut,ux that are the indicated time and space slice derivatives at x,t, satisfying pt+bulkModulus*ux=0 and ut+density inverse*px=0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both scalar equations simultaneously, with each derivative linked to the correct function and variable.",
      "source_match": "Matches both equations of (1.5). HasDerivAt makes the source's meaningful classical partial derivatives explicit without imposing C1 or joint differentiability.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "NumStability.IsConstantCoefficientLinearSystemSolutionAt._proof_1",
      "reuse_sha256": "d8321c6a827f9411a900d2f1f382b3b341cb28f478df2fa0d6717c52e6294889",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of the standard scalar action for derivatives valued in the two-coordinate function space.",
      "source_match": "Supports ordinary differentiation in R²; adds no hypothesis on acoustic solutions.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "NumStability.IsLinearAcousticsSolutionAt._proof_1",
      "interpretation": "Continuity of real scalar multiplication on Real, using real multiplication and the displayed standard real topologies.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity instance for scalar HasDerivAt assertions in D006.",
      "source_match": "Matches ordinary real partial differentiation and imposes no extra regularity assumption on p or u.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Iff",
      "reuse_sha256": "af2b5efd77411686ed07b88c9f537abe83f96d9d93f22c4a4f39d6f4882bf123",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts both directions between the matrix and scalar solution predicates.",
      "source_match": "The source's rewriting with explicitly specified q and A supports equivalence by component expansion.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Nat",
      "reuse_sha256": "c97e25fd0750ab5f0904d7bf50363984fcbd92a4a392fc62d9c63c9842f8c9ac",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the dimension parameter 2 and lengths used in vector construction.",
      "source_match": "Matches the two entries and two rows displayed in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Ne",
      "interpretation": "Negation of equality of its two arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "The outer premise excludes density=0.",
      "source_match": "Matches the domain required for the ordinary reciprocal 1/ρ in (1.5) and (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "reuse_sha256": "142ee4053e0a8b0b319d34f09d66e5af1443cf9cbec2a3c2a243fa0cec9263e2",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves dimension 2 and zero literals through their displayed natural, real, or vector instances.",
      "source_match": "Preserves the source's dimension and zero coefficients and right-hand sides.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Real",
      "reuse_sha256": "02faad1bb6ed958e3bbf3e1a92e1bd8791ee8650308fa0a9c31f68d89a7ae8bc",
      "effect_on_target": "All coordinates, parameters, function values, and derivative values are real.",
      "source_match": "Matches the real framework stated after (1.1) on printed page 1.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "reuse_sha256": "1735107ce188e214f37d41c83189e23bc90525ca0c50e33cdbdb5ee7094eaf56",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real zero for the density exclusion, matrix diagonal, and scalar residual equalities.",
      "source_match": "Matches the ordinary zeros in (1.5)–(1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "reuse_sha256": "344a0c889ab05c11c03b05649ec8f65758dd31f0d3eade757282d6202a2d72c5",
      "effect_on_target": "Turns the zero instances into the literal zeros appearing in the target and predicates.",
      "source_match": "Preserves scalar zero and the componentwise zero vector.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "interpretation": "Assigns the natural-number literal n the natural number n itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the explicit dimension literal 2 denote exactly two.",
      "source_match": "Matches the two-dimensional state and matrix of (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "interpretation": "Projects the function supplied by a DFunLike instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the Matrix.of equivalence to be applied to the nested vector of entries.",
      "source_match": "Introduces no change to the displayed matrix entries or ordering.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Equiv",
      "interpretation": "The library type of equivalences between two types, used here for Matrix.of.",
      "effect_on_target": "Packages the identity identification of an entry function with a matrix; it introduces no existential choice of matrix.",
      "source_match": "Preserves the explicitly prescribed matrix A in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Equiv.instEquivLike",
      "interpretation": "Uses an equivalence's toFun and invFun as its forward and inverse functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the forward function of Matrix.of when constructing A.",
      "source_match": "The forward function is the identity here, so the source matrix is preserved.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "EquivLike.toFunLike",
      "interpretation": "Retains the forward coercion of an EquivLike instance in a FunLike instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables applying Matrix.of without transforming its entries.",
      "source_match": "Matches the direct matrix construction in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Fin",
      "reuse_sha256": "400cbb2918219e4d19d4d4dc96246166eb5538267f4a57a6e94e9e5cee0ba384",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 2 supplies exactly indices 0 and 1 for state components, rows, and columns.",
      "source_match": "Encodes the source's two components with a harmless zero-based indexing convention.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "reuse_sha256": "5d2d298e2c15f8cfbdc7fdfbe5b34925f8765f506944706a0ab90a3e1aa3e75d",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures matrix-vector multiplication sums over both column indices exactly once.",
      "source_match": "Matches the complete two-term row products in A qx.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "interpretation": "Projects the inverse operation from the selected Inv instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses real inversion for density in the matrix and scalar equation.",
      "source_match": "For the required nonzero density, this is the coefficient 1/ρ in (1.5)–(1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "reuse_sha256": "b63ca985625814b3999a7dd85b17eb0f93e779401c1e076cca172eca6d60d98c",
      "effect_on_target": "Represents A by a real entry for each row and column in Fin 2.",
      "source_match": "Matches the real two-by-two matrix in (1.6), without transposition.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Matrix.of",
      "interpretation": "The reflexive equivalence identifying row-column entry functions with matrices.",
      "effect_on_target": "Leaves the nested vector's entries unchanged when constructing A.",
      "source_match": "Preserves rows (0,K) and (1/ρ,0) exactly.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Matrix.vecCons",
      "interpretation": "Prepends a head value to a Fin-indexed vector using Fin.cons.",
      "effect_on_target": "Places pressure before velocity and constructs matrix rows and entries in their written order.",
      "source_match": "Matches pressure-first column ordering and the off-diagonal positions in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Matrix.vecEmpty",
      "interpretation": "The empty Fin 0 vector, defined by elimination of its impossible index.",
      "effect_on_target": "Terminates the two-element state and matrix row constructions, adding no further components.",
      "source_match": "Matches the exact two-component dimensions of (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Real.instInv",
      "interpretation": "Selects the library real inverse operation Real.inv'.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies density inverse in both predicates. The theorem's density≠0 premise prevents use of the totalized zero-inverse case.",
      "source_match": "Matches ordinary 1/ρ on the source's meaningful reciprocal domain.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "And",
      "reuse_sha256": "e86d66198ff82d3da634b9b5de072b35c6d516aa2c1388860058deb28c8d9efc",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires every derivative assertion and both scalar residual equalities together.",
      "source_match": "Preserves the simultaneous system (1.5), rather than selecting either equation.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "reuse_sha256": "c2604435ef1b87c8be8deacec0e04ad31fcc57464d75f7eaa27c636a30c098c3",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies Real's nontrivially normed field structure to the derivative predicates.",
      "source_match": "Supports standard real differentiation without changing the source domain.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "reuse_sha256": "d23b1156d74d42591ec76227f843da7c5f073513fb248937a452585aa1233964",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in the scalar-module instance chain.",
      "source_match": "Maintains the ordinary arithmetic used in (1.5)–(1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Eq",
      "reuse_sha256": "05db50b6838dd939470f048dea1c2671ff96d987c0eacbf4a2093edadd5b6189",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires exact zero scalar and vector residuals and supplies the equality negated by density≠0.",
      "source_match": "Matches exact equalities in (1.5) and the matrix system.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Exists",
      "reuse_sha256": "f807c65b7bf0fa7fd41172aa38d62f19caa27513549c7f4fe4e7dfa44dd8aef4",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies derivative values locally at the fixed functions and point; HasDerivAt constrains them to actual derivatives.",
      "source_match": "Makes the source's partial derivatives meaningful without allowing arbitrary residual-canceling witnesses.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "reuse_sha256": "d95c32e7de98d0e5bdcae29bce524846bb6f218d90c8e4fbd62303d7fa825f25",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains real field operations in the derivative scalar-module infrastructure.",
      "source_match": "Does not alter the coefficients or real arithmetic of the source.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "reuse_sha256": "b5f4c802aa7d4b484534581502b5b4559c61e497769556a65575c06e57fc3fb9",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides finite enumeration for the Fin 2 sum in matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "source_match": "Matches the finite two-column matrix action, with no omitted indices.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "reuse_sha256": "02d9c52f51f26558960f5b1a7a24e83011177f5815524dbf2a79d31293470d9f",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses scalar real addition in D006 and pointwise vector addition in D005.",
      "source_match": "Matches the plus signs in the scalar and vector systems.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "interpretation": "Projects multiplication from its HMul instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the real coefficient-derivative products bulkModulus*ux and density inverse*px.",
      "source_match": "Matches the two coupling products in (1.5).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "reuse_sha256": "cfa259ac82269f5829880348da465a271d3229b0e87c37ce11b8bd80260c31e5",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires ordinary derivatives of one-variable time and space slices. For the Fin 2 product codomain these exist exactly when both coordinate derivatives exist.",
      "source_match": "Matches the partial-derivative convention following (1.1) and its use in (1.5); it does not replace absent derivatives with default values.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "reuse_sha256": "86ef6f9fb59bc235d1b457827b7f68add8487b85a1568d121e72f8fedd2834e4",
      "effect_on_target": "Computes A(px,ux)=(K ux,ρ inverse px) by row dot products.",
      "source_match": "Matches left multiplication of the spatial derivative column in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "reuse_sha256": "91043e33772a84484ecb2fa7bb01640e8bda6226dbcf35ca650487cbce7d064f",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains real ring operations on the instance path supporting matrix products.",
      "source_match": "Preserves ordinary real row-product arithmetic.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "reuse_sha256": "cdde9bd276f6789d2befc06884c8fec991ac82061c5ff0b93ef889d6b6c0cd0f",
      "effect_on_target": "Projects the same real operations for matrix multiplication infrastructure.",
      "source_match": "Does not change A qx or its scalar components.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "reuse_sha256": "fa167eb2a722c397a1da95139cbf0bc29ba529d33f702205b36fbc066bc4ef54",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the unchanged real addition and multiplication required by Matrix.mulVec.",
      "source_match": "Matches exact matrix-vector arithmetic in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "reuse_sha256": "12bc81e768660225dcd53ced55b200db9a901a15e66f7ad15557838fbee2b15d",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real additive structure for sums and module construction.",
      "source_match": "Preserves ordinary summation of the source's real quantities.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "reuse_sha256": "9173008e965afe38095b9e0111cea85d97ec4d39df833d9a7f730b51cb936b42",
      "effect_on_target": "Extracts real algebraic operations from the normed structure for matrix arithmetic.",
      "source_match": "No change to source arithmetic and no norm bound added.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "reuse_sha256": "aba329f01fe1a483789ac86918df395d5c066d445a93e7c1dc54ddf045a102c5",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real seminormed structure used to obtain derivative module instances.",
      "source_match": "Supports the standard real calculus underlying the source's derivatives.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "reuse_sha256": "cb1f6b5464ffbe445c485a81bf47ea559d7eef549cfe34a9b4923b3bc8310d41",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real additive group and metric in the normed-space instance chain.",
      "source_match": "Maintains ordinary real derivative semantics without an extra bound or regularity class.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "reuse_sha256": "84aae6df9d0dd2828744960e7c6a6b55daee60513fda8323bcb55e3f373584a0",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real arithmetic when obtaining additive structure for scalar actions.",
      "source_match": "Introduces no modification of the source's coefficients or equations.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "reuse_sha256": "f5c28d2d3755a068fac4adc1c938030519477683161e05329827944e04e96524",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides Real's existing normed field to derivative and topology instances.",
      "source_match": "Matches real calculus in the inherited context of (1.1).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "reuse_sha256": "881abdaa80d944b0f2eb0ee5afb592ff43108369832a491c9f684bd2a1966086",
      "effect_on_target": "Copies the existing real arithmetic and metric into the structure used by matrix arithmetic.",
      "source_match": "Preserves exact real products and sums; omitting a structure field does not restrict the real domain.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "reuse_sha256": "ccb43e6c1240be79b602da80914be760083f194106470915e3d22b0b7a55aae6",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the standard real norm, arithmetic, and metric into derivative topology construction.",
      "source_match": "Matches the standard real setting; introduces no alternative metric.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "reuse_sha256": "4c38eb105abe524748f51d4828edbe30af7277375926be50f25277e2649e6609",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the unchanged real field operations to the scalar-module chain.",
      "source_match": "Preserves ordinary real arithmetic in (1.5)–(1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "reuse_sha256": "b745cefa24060cdc3192fe7df7a8c5263c32adc9c090b7bf03fb6e851f100d2d",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Real a normed space over itself by ordinary multiplication.",
      "source_match": "Matches the scalar action used in real differentiation.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "reuse_sha256": "0b70701e03a8ea131e2883aa1c9d385ada63e25004dd2fc045f578fb21d017d6",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real scalar module underlying derivative assertions.",
      "source_match": "Adds no equation or restriction beyond the source's real vector-space setting.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "reuse_sha256": "05053047b1a3c50172ad96cc4309bd1d77d6451a31a74cdc0bab87905a691475",
      "effect_on_target": "Equips Fin 2→Real with coordinatewise real module operations for vector differentiation.",
      "source_match": "Matches the vector-space structure of the column q in (1.6).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "reuse_sha256": "fd838bf6d6aac9b12069308ef57f7f50eeaeb3c2d2fb740c13c6b166383c8d63",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides coordinatewise addition and subtraction for derivative vectors.",
      "source_match": "Matches ordinary R² vector arithmetic.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "reuse_sha256": "c4f40f8305e9365d5c20502eaa31283cee6872f86d5405f732f1b8a8a94fa314",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes qt+A qx have components pt+K ux and ut+ρ inverse px.",
      "source_match": "Exactly recovers the two left-hand sides in (1.5).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "reuse_sha256": "2a492ceca1f9f3efa0662ba829d4e22b44fb3eec8b249c65c20b4e6429454fb5",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector residual must vanish in both coordinates.",
      "source_match": "Matches the two scalar zero right-hand sides represented by the matrix-system zero.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "reuse_sha256": "460e9c43d81e08a5f313adebced5690bcb429f6b330a8d9a947b7125d1483d89",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the product of two standard real topologies, so vector slice differentiation agrees with coordinate differentiation.",
      "source_match": "Matches the ordinary topology of R² implicit in the source's vector derivatives.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
